postrun_guard_review.review_type: Post-run code guard audit; runtime outputs remain immutable

source_difference.change: Receive all cross-session rows; report each training connection lacking a whole-pair holdout instead of examining only pairs having heldouts.
Exclude held_out type0 odometry before passing to legacy optimize(), which filters only loop holdouts.

postrun_guard_review.rerun_reason: No reserved odometry was present, so input factors and fitted poses are numerically unaffected. Additional missing-audit guard only changes explanatory metadata; every runtime variant was already rejected.

selection_bias.description: collect_normals calls fit_planes(train,test); the within-frame test samples select accepted plane factors, and some global geometry diagnostics reuse those same test voxels. These metrics are conditional on factor selection, not untouched independent validation.
selection_bias.finite_plane_note: Finite-plane patch acceptance also uses reserved within-frame samples; selected-patch consistency is conditional and correlated with factor construction.
selection_bias.same_sensor_note: Nearby-frame surface checks and same-frame depth splits remain correlated measurements, not surveyed ground truth.

postrun_guard_review.correlation_note: Exact pair deduplication is present; uncertainty and Huber losses are modeling choices. Overlapping/repeated physical regions can remain statistically correlated and do not establish three independent regions.
postrun_guard_review.validation: 10 targeted tests passed, including an unaudited connection hidden by another audited connection and a huge-information heldout odometry edge; git diff --check passed.

fixed_patch_metric_definition: Distribution of per-patch symmetric absolute plane-distance medians, metres; not surveyed error.
